name: Cockpit shows the accrued total before any payment
title: SC-02-01-01 Cockpit shows the accrued total before any payment
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given dues of "1400.00" are accrued for every unit
When the Site Manager opens the management dashboard
Then the collected amount is "0.00" and the badge starts with "%0"
